strapiBlog.title: Muraba Veil: Dubai’s Skinniest Skyscraper, One Apartment Wide

data.text:
Dubai, known for its groundbreaking architecture and iconic skyline, is about to add yet another marvel to its collection. The Muraba Veil, a super-thin skyscraper that spans only a single apartment across, is planned to rise among the properties along the stunning Dubai Canal. This exceptional project promises to be a unique blend of architectural elegance, luxurious living, and cultural homage to traditional Arabian design. With every floor dedicated to just one residence, Muraba Veil is poised to offer an exclusive and private lifestyle in one of the world’s most dynamic cities.

What Sets Muraba Veil Apart?

The Muraba Veil’s defining feature is its ultra-slim structure, making it the skinniest skyscraper in Dubai. Standing at an impressive 1,247 feet yet only 74 feet wide, this 73-story marvel redefines vertical living in Dubai. The building’s design incorporates a stainless steel “veil” that gracefully wraps around its facade, adding a sleek, modern look while serving practical purposes. The veil not only reflects the hues of Dubai’s sky throughout the day but also optimizes privacy without sacrificing natural light.

Rafael Aranda, founder of RCR Arquitectes, said in a press statement: “We are passionate about ensuring our buildings are responsive to the place, that they belong to the site and the native landscape where they are situated. They must communicate with nature and be infused with the atmosphere of the local culture.”

Exclusivity in Every Residence

With just one apartment per floor, each residence in Muraba Veil provides unmatched privacy and panoramic views of the Dubai Canal, the city skyline, and the Arabian Gulf. The development features 131 Exclusive Residences available in the configuration of 2 to 5 bedrooms, all designed to maximize space and light. Inspired by traditional Arabian homes, these residences are arranged around internal courtyards, creating a tranquil oasis amidst the vibrant cityscape. This combination of Arabian influence and modern elegance makes Muraba Veil a truly unique offering in Dubai’s luxury property market.

Luxury Amenities for a Holistic Lifestyle

The upcoming project in Dubai, Muraba Veil, has thoughtfully curated amenities to enhance residents’ lifestyles. From a luxurious spa and private movie theater to an art gallery and exclusive padel court, the building caters to wellness, entertainment, and social experiences. A fully-equipped fitness center, a vitality pool, and steam rooms are also available for those seeking relaxation and rejuvenation. These amenities make Muraba Veil more than just a residence; it’s a holistic experience crafted for those who value exclusivity and luxury.

Prime Location Along the Dubai Canal

Positioned along the scenic Dubai Canal and close to Sheikh Zayed Road, Muraba Veil offers residents the perfect blend of convenience and tranquility. This prime location provides easy access to Dubai’s major landmarks, including Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and the Burj Khalifa. Surrounded by waterfront views and vibrant city life, Muraba Veil promises a sophisticated urban lifestyle with the added charm of a peaceful retreat by the canal.

A Masterpiece by Renowned Architects

Designed by the acclaimed RCR Arquitectes, and winners of the Pritzker Prize, Muraba Veil represents an architectural philosophy rooted in blending structures with the local landscape. The architects' focus on cultural resonance, light, and space is evident in Muraba Veil’s design, making it both a tribute to Dubai’s heritage and a contemporary icon.

data.text:
Why Invest in Muraba Veil?

Investing in Muraba Veil means owning a piece of Dubai’s ever-evolving skyline. With its unparalleled privacy, luxurious amenities, and iconic design, Muraba Veil is a rare opportunity for investors and residents alike. Its location along the Dubai Canal, combined with the exclusivity of one apartment per floor, ensures that Muraba Veil is both a sound investment and a statement in luxury living.

In conclusion, Muraba Veil stands as a symbol of Dubai’s ambition and innovation in the world of luxury real estate. As this super-thin skyscraper takes shape, it promises to elevate Dubai’s architectural landscape and offer a new level of exclusivity and elegance for discerning residents. Whether as a home or an investment, Muraba Veil offers an unparalleled opportunity to be part of Dubai’s iconic skyline.

faqs.question: What is the starting price of properties in Muraba Veil?

data.answer: The minimum sales price of an apartment in Muraba Veil is AED 18 million ($4.9 million).

faqs.question: What is the skinniest skyscraper in the world?

data.answer: The world's skinniest skyscraper is Steinway Tower, located in New York City. This residential building stands at 1,428 feet (435 meters) tall and has a width-to-height ratio of approximately 1:24, making it the most slender skyscraper globally.

faqs.question: Who is the architect behind Muraba Veil?

data.answer: The project is designed by RCR Arquitectes, a Pritzker Prize-winning Spanish architecture firm known for its innovative and minimalist designs.

faqs.question: When is the expected completion date for Muraba Veil?

data.answer: Muraba Veil is currently under construction, with an estimated handover date in December 2028.
